title: qauth-vectors/1
description: A QAuth shared test vector file. Two rules sit outside this schema and are checked by the validator: case ids are unique within a file, and every JWK (an object with a kty member) has a kid that starts with "throwaway-test-".

schema.description: The format version. A reader refuses a file whose version it does not know.

id.description: The path of the file under test-vectors/, without .json, such as pkce/s256.

description.description: What the cases test, and what input and expected mean in this file. A reader in another language implements the check from this text.

source.description: Where the cases come from: a specification section, or the tool and version that generated them.

id.description: Lower-case and hyphenated, unique within the file. A merged case id always means the same input and the same expected result.

input.description: What the code under test receives. The file's description says what it means.

expected.description: What the code under test must produce from the input.

notes.description: Why the case exists, or where its values come from.

items.description: One case: an input and the result expected from it.

cases.description: At least one case. Case ids are unique within the file.
